entries.summary: We prove a common generalization of two structure theorems: the dimension-free decomposition theorem for idempotent Schur multipliers and the idempotent theorem in harmonic analysis. Roughly speaking, our result shows that an invariant integer-valued kernel with Hilbert-space factorization norm $γ$ admits a signed decomposition into at most $2^{O(γ^4)}$ elementary pieces. entries.title: Two Questions on $G$-harmonic Tuples
entries.summary: An $n$-tuple of positive integers is $G$-harmonic if there are subgroups of $G$ having those indices whose cosets can be chosen pairwise disjoint, and $\mathbb{Z}$-harmonic if there are pairwise disjoint residue classes with those moduli. entries.title: Kakeya sets and dimension compression in compact Lie groups
entries.summary: We study two Kakeya set problems in compact semisimple Lie groups. In this paper, we demonstrate that Howe duality provides the underlying structure of the super Landau model, reflecting a general feature of coset-type Landau models. The (super) Howe duality relates different Landau levels and accounts for the emergence of a dual fuzzy geometry. entries.summary: In this review, we present a general framework for the construction of Kac-Moody (KM) algebras associated to higher-dimensional manifolds. entries.summary: Guided by symmetry principles, we construct an effective field theory that captures the long-wavelength dynamics of two-dimensional vortex crystals observed in rotating Bose-Einstein condensates trapped in a harmonic potential. entries.summary: We elaborate the definition and properties of "massive" elementary systems in the $(1+3)$-dimensional Anti-de Sitter (AdS$_4$) spacetime, on both classical and quantum levels. entries.title: Free nilspaces, double-coset nilspaces, and Gowers norms
entries.summary: Compact finite-rank nilspaces have become central in the nilspace approach to higher-order Fourier analysis, notably through their role in a general form of the inverse theorem for the Gowers norms. This paper studies these nilspaces per se, and in connection with further refinements of this inverse theorem that have been conjectured recently. entries.title: The Herzog-Schönheim Conjecture for small groups and harmonic subgroups
entries.summary: We prove that the Herzog-Schönheim Conjecture holds for any group $G$ of order smaller than $1440$. entries.title: An analytic superfield formalism for tree superamplitudes in D=10 and D=11

entries.title: Harmony of Spinning Conformal Blocks
entries.summary: Conformal blocks for correlation functions of tensor operators play an increasingly important role for the conformal bootstrap programme. We develop a universal approach to such spinning blocks through the harmonic analysis of certain bundles over a coset of the conformal group. entries.title: Low-Energy QCD in the Delta Regime
entries.summary: We investigate properties of low-energy QCD in a finite spatial volume, but with arbitrary temperature. entries.summary: Spinor description for the curvatures of $D=5$ Yang-Mills, Rarita-Schwinger and gravitational fields is elaborated. entries.title: Quantum mechanics of a generalised rigid body
entries.summary: We consider the quantum version of Arnold's generalisation of a rigid body in classical mechanics. Thus, we quantise the motion on an arbitrary Lie group manifold of a particle whose classical trajectories correspond to the geodesics of any one-sided-invariant metric. We show how the derivation of the spectrum of energy eigenstates can be simplified by making use of automorphisms of the Lie algebra and (for groups of Type I) by methods of harmonic analysis. entries.title: Twistors, Harmonics and Holomorphic Chern-Simons
entries.summary: We show that the off-shell N=3 action of N=4 super Yang-Mills can be written as a holomorphic Chern-Simons action whose Dolbeault operator is constructed from a complex-real (CR) structure of harmonic space. We also show that the local space-time operators can be written as a Penrose transform on the coset SU(3)/(U(1) \times U(1)). We observe a strong similarity to ambitwistor space constructions.

entries.title: Large N anomalous dimensions for large operators in Leigh-Strassler deformed SYM
entries.summary: We study the large N anomalous dimensions of operators in a Leigh-Strassler deformation of N=4 super Yang-Mills theory. The operators that we study have a bare dimension of order N (so that the large N limit is not captured by planar diagrams) and are AdS/CFT dual to giant gravitons. The diagonalization of the dilatation operator factorizes into two problems. One of these problems is solved using a double coset ansatz. The second problem is equivalent to a set of decoupled harmonic oscillators.

entries.title: Harmonic Superspace Gaugeon Formalism for the ABJM Theory
entries.summary: In this paper we will analyse the ABJM theory in harmonic superspace. The harmonic superspace variables will be parameterized by the coset $SU(2)/U(1)$ and thus will have manifest $\mathcal{N} =3$ supersymmetry. We will study the quantum gauge transformations and the BRST transformations of this theory in gaugeon formalism. We will use this BRST symmetry to project out the physical sub-space from the total Hilbert space. We will also show that the evolution of the $\mathcal{S}$-matrix is unitary for this ABJM theory in harmonic superspace.

entries.title: M-theory/type IIA duality and K3 in the Gibbons-Hawking approximation
entries.summary: We review the geometry of K3 surfaces and then describe this geometry from the point of view of an approximate metric of Gibbons-Hawking form. entries.title: Construction of the noncommutative rank I Bergman domain
entries.summary: In this paper we present a harmonic oscillator realization of the most degenerate discrete series representations of the SU(2,1) group and the deformation quantization of the coset space $D=SU(2,1)/U(2)$ with the method of coherent state quantization.

entries.title: A double coset ansatz for integrability in AdS/CFT

entries.title: Goldstino superfields for spontaneously broken N=2 supersymmetry
entries.summary: We examine spontaneously broken N=2 supersymmetry in four dimensions and associate a spinor superfield with each Goldstino via a finite supersymmetry transformation with parameters that are the Grassmann coordinates of N=2 superspace. entries.title: Quantum Algorithms for Simon's Problem Over General Groups
entries.summary: Daniel Simon's 1994 discovery of an efficient quantum algorithm for solving the hidden subgroup problem (HSP) over Z_2^n provided one of the first algebraic problems for which quantum computers are exponentially faster than their classical counterparts. entries.title: The Fuzzy S^4 by Quantum Deformation
entries.summary: The fuzzy algebra of S^4 is discussed by quantum deformation. To this end we embed the classical S^4 in the Kaehler coset space SO(5)/U(2). entries.title: Harmonic Analysis and Superconformal Gauge Theories in Three Dimensions from AdS/CFT Correspondence
entries.summary: In this thesis I review various aspects of the AdS_4/CFT_3 correspondence, where AdS_4 supergravity arises from compactification of M-theory on a coset space G/H and preserves N<8 supersymmetries. entries.title: Representations of (1,0) and (2,0) superconformal algebras in six dimensions: massless and short superfields
entries.summary: We construct unitary representations of (1,0) and (2,0) superconformal algebras in six dimensions by using superfields defined on harmonic superspaces with coset manifolds USp(2n)/[U(1)]^n, n=1,2. entries.summary: We present the general solution of the system of coupled nonlinear equations describing dynamics of $D$--dimensional bosonic string in the geometric (or embedding) approach. entries.summary: This part II of the paper is concerned with questions of existence and uniqueness of tangents in the special case of G-plurisubharmonic functions, where G is a compact subset of the Grassmannian of p-planes in ${\mathbb R}^n$. An upper semi-continuous function u on an open set $Ω$ in ${\mathbb R}^n$ is G-plurisubharmonic if its restriction to $Ω\cap W$ is subharmonic for every affine G-plane $W$. entries.title: Geometric plurisubharmonicity and convexity - an introduction
entries.summary: This is an essay on potential theory for geometric plurisubharmonic functions. It begins with a given closed subset G of the Grassmann bundle $G(p,TX)$ of tangent $p$-planes to a riemannian manifold $X$. This determines a nonlinear partial differential equation which is convex but never uniformly elliptic (p < dim X). A surprising number of results in complex analysis carry over to this more general setting. entries.title: A Probabilistic Characterization of g-Harmonic Functions
entries.summary: This paper gives a definition of g-harmonic functions and shows the relation between the g-harmonic functions and g-martingales. It's direct to construct such relation under smooth case, but for continuous case we need the theory of viscosity solution. The results show that under the nonlinear expectation mechanism, we also can get the similar relation between harmonic functions and martingales. Finally, we will give a result about the strict converse problem of mean value property of g-harmonic functions.

entries.title: On Sun's conjecture concerning disjoint cosets
entries.summary: In 2004, Zhi-Wei Sun posed the following conjecture: If a_1G_1,...,a_kG_k (k>1) are finitely many pairwise disjoint left cosets in a group G with all the indices [G:G_i] finite, then for some 1\le i<j\le k, the greatest common divisor of [G:G_i] and [G:G_j] is at least k. In this paper, we confirm Sun's conjecture for k=3,4.

We study neural networks trained to predict the running product of group elements. We identify quotient solutions in Transformers, where models recover the quotient class while predicting nearly uniformly among its members. entries.summary: We resolve two open problems regarding uniquely colorable Cayley graphs posed by Klotz and Sander (2017). entries.title: Function-Correcting Partition Codes
entries.summary: We introduce function-correcting partition codes (FCPCs), which are a natural generalization of function-correcting codes (FCCs). An FCPC is defined directly on a partition of the message space, rather than on a specific target function. entries.title: Learning a Group Element from Its Action: Galois Correspondences, Optimal ERM, and an Abel-Ruffini Threshold for the Natarajan Dimension

entries.title: N-ary groups of panmagic permutations from the Post coset theorem
entries.summary: Panmagic permutations are permutations whose matrices are panmagic squares, better known as solutions to the modular n-queens problem, configurations of n non-attacking queens on a toroidal nxn chessboard. Some of them, affine panmagic permutations, can be conveniently described by linear formulas of modular arithmetic, and we show that their sets are a generalization of groups with N-ary multiplication instead of binary one. With the help of the Post coset theorem, we identify panmagic N-ary groups as cosets of the dihedral subgroup and its extensions in the group of all affine permutations.

entries.summary: This paper proposes the design of polar and convolutional coset codes for the unequal message protection (UMP) in the short blocklength regime, to overcome the rate loss introduced by preamble-based solutions. entries.title: New classes of IYB groups
entries.summary: It is proven that every finite group of odd order with all Sylow subgroups of nilpotency class at most two is an involutive Yang-Baxter group (IYB group for short), i.e. it admits a structure of left brace. It is also proven that every finite solvable group of even order with all Sylow subgroups of nilpotency class at most two and abelian Sylow 2-subgroups is an IYB group. entries.title: Quantization of locally compact groups associated with essentially bijective $1$-cocycles
entries.summary: Given an extension $0\to V\to G\to Q\to1$ of locally compact groups, with $V$ abelian, and a compatible essentially bijective $1$-cocycle $η\colon Q\to\hat V$, we define a dual unitary $2$-cocycle on $G$ and show that the associated deformation of $\hat G$ is a cocycle bicrossed product defined by a matched pair of subgroups of $Q\ltimes\hat V$. entries.title: Nilpotency of Bocksteins, Kropholler's hierarchy and a conjecture of Moore
entries.summary: A conjecture of Moore claims that if G is a group and H a finite index subgroup of G such that G - H has no elements of prime order (e.g. G is torsion free), then a G-module which is projective over H is projective over G. The conjecture is known for finite groups. entries.title: Uniform Intersection Numbers and Subgroup-Based Generating Graphs of Groups
entries.summary: The uniform intersection number of a finite group $G$, denoted by $ui(G)$, is the smallest positive integer $k$ such that the intersection of any $k$ distinct maximal subgroups of $G$ is equal to its Frattini subgroup. We determine the uniform intersection number of dicyclic, dihedral, and quasi-dihedral groups. entries.title: Global transfer systems and endopurity of subgroups
entries.summary: Global transfer systems are combinatorial objects that parametrize intermediate levels of structures and properties in globally equivariant homotopy theory. In this paper we study the lattice of global transfer systems, expanding beyond the case of abelian groups which was computed by the second author. The main result is a proof that the irreducible elements of the lattice of global transfer systems are strictly controlled by subgroups of groups which we refer to as endopure. entries.summary: We provide a set of group properties that together obstruct membership in the quasivariety that Brodskiĭ constructed in his proof that torsion-free one-relator groups are locally indicable. There are examples of locally indicable groups with these properties, which implies that Brodskiĭ's quasivariety is strictly contained in the quasivariety of all locally indicable groups. This disproves a conjecture of Howie.

entries.title: Multivariate $P$- and $Q$-polynomial structures of generalized Johnson association schemes
entries.summary: Let $\mathfrak X$ be a commutative association scheme of class $d$ on $X$. We construct the generalized Johnson association scheme $\mathfrak J_{n,h}(\mathfrak X)$ on partial maps from $[n]$ to $X$ with domains of size $h$. For $1\le h\le n-1$, we prove that $\mathfrak J_{n,h}(\mathfrak X)$ has $(d+1)$-variate $P$- and $Q$-polynomial structures. entries.title: Automorphisms of Free Metabelian Lie Algebras, II
entries.summary: We show that every automorphism of the free metabelian Lie algebra $M_n$ of rank $n\geq 4$ over an arbitrary field $K$ is almost tame; that is, it can be expressed as a product of Chein automorphisms (also called one-row transformations). Moreover, we prove that, for $n\geq 4$, the group $\mathrm{Aut}(M_n)$ of all automorphisms of the free metabelian Lie algebra $M_n$ over a field $K$ of characteristic not equal to $3$ is generated by its linear automorphisms, together with a single quadratic and a single cubic automorphism. The same result holds for fields of any characteristic if $n\geq 5$.

entries.title: Cayley graphs of abelian groups, circular colorings and discrete fundamental groups
entries.summary: For each integer $k \ge 2$, we prove that an abelian group $Γ$ satisfies $\exp(Γ) \in \{1,\dots,k\} \cup \{2,4,\dots,2k\}$ if and only if it admits no non-bipartite Cayley graph whose circular chromatic number is strictly less than $2 + \frac{2}{k-1}$. This refines the algebraic characterization by Krebs and Sankar of abelian groups that admit $3$-chromatic Cayley graphs.

entries.summary: It is a well-known fact that every proper quotient of a branch group is a virtually abelian group. entries.summary: For every additively idempotent semiring $S$ in the constant-free signature, $S$ is finitely based if and only if $S\times E$ is finitely based when $E=M_2$ or $T_2$. entries.summary: We show that if $G$ is a finite solvable group such that $E = \mathbb Q(\{χ(g)\, |\, χ\in{\rm Irr}(G),\ g \in G\})$ is an extension of degree 2 over the rationals, then $E = \mathbb Q(\sqrt{\pm d})$ for a positive integer $d$ all of whose prime divisors lie in $\{2, 3, 5\}$. entries.title: Drift and joint minimal displacement for groups acting on hyperbolic spaces
entries.summary: We obtain a uniform lower bound for the drift of random walks on hyperbolic spaces in terms of joint minimal displacement. For discrete isometry groups of Hadamard manifolds with pinched negative curvature, the required assumptions are automatically satisfied by the Margulis lemma. entries.title: Prefixes of Coxeter elements are Coxeter elements of the reflection subgroups they generate

entries.title: Invariable Generation of Groups of Homeomorphisms
entries.summary: We provide a sufficient condition for a group of homeomorphisms of a compact Hausdorff space to be non-invariably generated, generalizing previous results proved using the dynamics of a group's action. We exhibit new applications among Scott-Röver-Nekrashevych groups and among groups of tree automorphism of with (almost) locally prescribed actions.

entries.title: Conformal dimension and self-similar groups

entries.title: An analog of Quillen-Venkov for eventually negligible classes and radicality for finite irreducible Coxeter groups

entries.title: Invariant factors from products of cyclotomic polynomials, with applications
entries.summary: Let $f,g\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be products of cyclotomic polynomials such that either $g/\gcd(f,g)$ or $f/\gcd(f,g)$ (or both) is squarefree. entries.title: The Euler Characteristic of Spherical Bestvina-Brady Kernels
entries.summary: We compute the Euler characteristic of Bestvina-Brady kernels $\operatorname{BB}(Γ)$ for all Artin groups of spherical type. entries.summary: We prove that if M is an abelian group and X = Alex(M, phi) is a Latin Alexander quandle with id - phi in Aut(M), then Aut(X) is isomorphic to M semidirect C_Aut(M)(phi), Inn(X) is isomorphic to M semidirect <phi> and Out(X) is isomorphic to C_Aut(M)(phi)/<phi>. entries.title: When do lazy and invertible cellular automata generate all cellular automata?
entries.summary: Let $G$ be a group and let $A$ be a set with at least two elements. A lazy cellular automaton over $A^G$ acts as the identity except at the cells where a fixed pattern occurs, where it replaces the central symbol by a fixed different symbol. entries.title: Lie groups are countably representable
entries.summary: We prove that every Lie group can be realized by permutations of a countable set, answering a classical question of Ulam. The key deformation construction originated in an argument produced by OpenAI's GPT 6 Astra during extended mathematical discussions.

entries.title: The group generated by a graph's derangements
entries.summary: We introduce the leap group of a graph, the subgroup of the symmetric group on the vertex set generated by graph derangements. We summarize historical results on graph derangements, which we call hops, and prove additional existence and complexity results. The leap groups of various canonical graphs are computed, and their behavior under basic graph operations is analyzed. We offer partial results on which groups can appear as leap groups, and study hops and leaps for infinite and directed graphs.

entries.title: A note on the proof of nonamenability of F
entries.summary: The goal of this note is to provide a human written exposition of OpenAI's recent proof that Thompson's group F is nonamenable.

entries.title: Finite groups with conjugacy classes of size $2p^n$

entries.title: The one percent property for free groups
entries.summary: We prove that for every $\varepsilon >0$, there is $δ>0$ such that for every probability measure $μ$ on a free group $\mathbb{F}$, if the operator norm of the action of $μ$ on $L^2\mathbb{F}$ by convolution exceeds $\varepsilon$, then there is a coset of an abelian subgroup of $\mathbb{F}$ with $μ$-mass at least $δ$.

entries.title: Groups with the fixed-point property
entries.summary: We propose the study of the class of groups that fix a point for every continuous action on any convex compact space. entries.summary: Let $\X$ be a variety of groups. A group $G$ is $\CSX$ if its maximal $\X$-subgroups are malnormal. We prove that the amalgamated free product of two $\CSX$-groups with a malnormal amalgam and without any involutions is again $\CSX$. entries.title: Quandles with isomorphic representation categories
entries.summary: We give two types of examples where two non isomorphic finite quandles have isomorphic enveloping groups. This implies that two non-isomorphic finite quandles can share isomorphic representation categories (as additive and tensor categories simultaneously).

entries.title: Matrix Waring Problem-III
entries.summary: Let $n,k$ be positive integers and $q$ be a prime power. We prove that there exists a real constant $C_k$ depending only on $k$ such that if $ \# M_n(\mathbb{F}_q) > C_k$ then every element in $M_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$ is a sum of two $k$th powers, proving Larsen's conjecture.

entries.title: Zero divisors in group algebras of torsion-free groups in odd characteristic

entries.title: Complete mappings stabilizing Sylow $2$-subgroups in central quotients of special linear groups
entries.summary: A complete mapping of a finite group $G$ is a permutation $θ$ of $G$ such that $x\mapsto xθ(x)$ is also a permutation of $G$. entries.title: On a finite group in which every non-supersolvable maximal subgroup is a TI-subgroup
entries.summary: We provide a complete characterization of a finite group in which every non-supersolvable maximal subgroup is a TI-subgroup, which generalizes some known related results.

entries.title: A characterization of central extensions relative to n-nilpotent objects
entries.summary: We characterize the central extensions, in the sense of the categorical theory of central extensions of Janelidze and Kelly, relative to the Birkhoff subcategory of $n$-nilpotent objects of a semi-abelian and algebraically coherent category. entries.summary: For every countable discrete group, we construct a character for finite-dimensional unitary quasi-representations, with values in the inverse limit of the equivariant $K$-theory of its Rips complexes. entries.title: An explicit construction of a limit variety of groups
entries.summary: We construct an explicit countable group \(G_*=N(R)\rtimes A\) whose generated variety is a limit variety of groups: it has no finite identity basis, whereas every proper subvariety is finitely based. entries.title: Profinite recognition of uniformity
entries.summary: Let $G$ be a semisimple Lie group that is not isogenous to the isometry group of real or complex hyperbolic $n$-space. entries.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $n$ and $X$ a finite $G$-set. entries.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and let $π(G)$ be the set of prime divisors of $|G|$. For each $p\in π(G)$, choose a Sylow $p$-subgroup $G_p$ of $G$. entries.summary: We study finite involutive multivalued groups associated with Schur rings. entries.title: Regular automorphisms of periodic $p'$-groups need not be splitting
entries.summary: For a fixed prime $p$, a group is called a $p'$-group if the orders of all its elements are coprime to $p$. entries.summary: We solve Brauer's Problem 33 by determining the finite $2$-groups that occur as Sylow $2$-subgroups of finite groups with a single conjugacy class of involutions.
